findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "about_signa" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "What Signa does, who it is for, how engagements work, and how to get in touch." → after: "Signa’s two offers, prices, who it is for, and how to get in touch."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
